caption: The drawing consists of six square sections, arranged in two horizontal rows of three squares each. The top left square features a white background with diagonal black dashed lines and intermittent thin red stripes. The top center square has a dark brown background with a blue-gray checked grid pattern. The top right square shows a cream or off-white background with a floral design that includes pink, yellow, and orange flowers, green leaves, and black vine-like details. The bottom left square consists of a dark brown background decorated with a pattern of small floral motifs in red, purple, and yellow, accompanied by greenish-gray leaves. The bottom center square is white or off-white with a repeating pattern of stylized black lowercase cursive "l" or "j" shapes. The bottom right square features a dark brown background with a pattern of purple circles and dots arranged in interconnected circular and curved motifs.
title: Materials from Quilt
